purpose: Verified 25-record batch 113 from the clean 306-record reference-dependent queue. Nineteen high-confidence candidates were carried forward after concurrent batch 112 consumed one overlap, and six additional records were reviewed from the fresh post-112 queue. The set is limited to complete source mechanics or explicit inheritance and avoids unresolved tables, damaged sources, and creature/stat-block-heavy dependencies.

spells/dragon-ally-4415.name: Dragon Ally
spells/dragon-ally-4415.effectSummary: Calls one dragon of up to 18 HD and lets you bargain for one task. You must communicate with it and pay before it agrees; bargaining takes at least 1 round, so service begins no earlier than the next round. The lesser-dragon-ally payment schedule applies: 50 gp per HD for up to 1 minute per caster level, 250 gp per HD for up to 1 hour per caster level, or 500 gp per HD for up to 1 day per caster level, with especially hazardous tasks costing up to twice as much. XP cost: 250.
spells/dragon-ally-4415.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 113 keeps a conservative size as the remaining queue becomes increasingly dependency-heavy.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/heart-of-water-879.name: Heart of Water
spells/heart-of-water-879.effectSummary: For 1 hour per caster level, grants a swim speed equal to land speed, including the normal swim-speed benefits, water breathing, and +5 enhancement on Escape Artist checks. As a swift action you can activate freedom of movement on yourself for 1 round per caster level; when that benefit ends, the entire Heart of Water effect ends. With another Heart spell active you gain light fortification, and with all four Heart spells active you become immune to extra critical-hit and sneak-attack damage.

spells/horizikauls-versatile-vibration-1.name: Horizikaul's Versatile Vibration
spells/horizikauls-versatile-vibration-1.effectSummary: Creates a sustained cone of powerful sound. In damage mode, creatures in the cone take 1 sonic damage per two caster levels each round, Reflex half. In movement mode, it functions like sustained-force telekinesis but can move objects or creatures only away from you; targets inside silence cannot be moved. The sound is as loud as a battle. Focus: a hollow brass-and-gold cone worth 50 gp.

spells/iron-body-2825.name: Iron Body
spells/iron-body-2825.effectSummary: Transforms you into living iron for 1 minute per caster level. You gain DR 15/adamantine; immunity to blindness, critical hits, ability-score damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and physiology/respiration effects; and take half acid and fire damage, while becoming vulnerable to attacks that specially affect iron golems. You gain +6 enhancement Strength, -6 Dexterity to minimum 1, half speed, 50% arcane spell failure, -8 armor-check penalty, armed club-equivalent unarmed attacks, and tenfold weight; you cannot drink or play wind instruments. Material component: iron from an iron golem, hero's armor, or war machine.

spells/lifebound-4800.name: Lifebound
spells/lifebound-4800.effectSummary: For a secretly rolled 1d6 rounds, binds a possessing spirit to its host and gives that spirit complete control of the host. The host uses its own attacks and special abilities but can also employ the possessing spirit's spell-like, psi-like, and supernatural abilities in forms appropriate to the host. If the host is slain, the possessing spirit is destroyed as well, though planar spirits can later reform under their normal planar rules. Each round the bound creature can spend a full-round action on the spell's special Will save; success lets the spirit abandon the host as a free action. Material component: a white diamond worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die of the possessing spirit.
spells/lifebound-4800.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 113 keeps a conservative size as the remaining queue becomes increasingly dependency-heavy.

spells/lord-of-the-sky-1071.name: Lord of the Sky
spells/lord-of-the-sky-1071.effectSummary: For 1 minute per caster level, grants fly speed 40 feet with good maneuverability, or 30 feet in medium/heavy armor or load; an existing fly speed of at least 40 feet instead improves by 10 feet and to good maneuverability. While airborne, each round you can use a swift action for a ranged touch lightning attack against an airborne target within 60 feet, dealing 1 electricity damage per caster level, maximum 20, and halving its fly speed for the duration without stacking. Once during the spell you can release a normal lightning bolt as a standard action, ending the spell; dragonblood casters receive the source's improved flight values.

spells/spell-matrix-4208.name: Spell Matrix
spells/spell-matrix-4208.effectSummary: Creates a matrix for 10 minutes per caster level that can store up to two Quicken-eligible spells of 3rd level or lower. You take 2d6 damage when creating it; the matrix closes after 2 rounds. Stored spells are treated as prepared and can be cast as swift actions. If both are 2nd level or lower, they can be linked and discharged together as one swift action. Dispel magic removes the matrix and stored spells; antimagic pauses it, and death dissipates it. Focus: a sapphire worth at least 1,000 gp.
spells/spell-matrix-4208.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 113 keeps a conservative size as the remaining queue becomes increasingly dependency-heavy.

spells/true-reincarnate-1937.name: True Reincarnate
spells/true-reincarnate-1937.effectSummary: Restores a willing creature dead up to 10 years per caster level in a new reincarnated body, even if the old body is completely destroyed when the creature can be identified unambiguously.
